```{r}
setwd("~/Desktop/Aiptasia_reanalyisis2024/")
# Load the data
data<-read.csv("Immune_data_2023_final.csv", header = TRUE)
str(data)
```

```{r}
# Calculate average control values of Phenoloxidase..U.mg., totProt,CarbsPerMgProt,PerActivity..μmoles.min.mg.protein. for each treatment of strain and symbiotic state
str(data)
control_avg <- aggregate(cbind(Phenoloxidase, totProt,CarbsPerMgProt,PerActivity) ~ Treatment + Strain + State, data = data[data$Treatment == "Control", ], mean)
```

```{r}
# Merge the average values with the original data matrix
data <- merge(data, control_avg, by = c("Strain", "State"), suffixes = c("", "_avg"))
```

```{r}
# Calculate relative change for each treatment relative to control average
data$Relative_Change_Phenoloxidase <- (data$Phenoloxidase- data$Phenoloxidase_avg) / data$Phenoloxidase_avg
data$Relative_Change_totProt <- (data$totProt - data$totProt_avg) / data$totProt_avg
data$Relative_Change_CarbsPerMgProt <- (data$CarbsPerMgProt - data$CarbsPerMgProt_avg) / data$CarbsPerMgProt_avg
data$Relative_Change_PerActivity <- (data$PerActivity - data$PerActivity_avg) / data$PerActivity_avg
data_baseline<-filter(data, Treatment=="Control")
# Rearrange the order of Treatment levels
data$Treatment <- factor(data$Treatment, levels = c("Control","Nitrate","Heat","Heat+Nitrate"))

```

```{r}
#Assign colors and shapes
#shapes

colvec<- c("Control" = "#4292c6", "Nitrate" = "#556B2F","Heat" = "coral1","Heat+Nitrate" = "#D65278")

#Pink: D65278
```

```{r}
#construct PCAl plot of all baseline data
# Extract numeric columns for PCA
str(data_baseline)
 #$ totProt                                : num  17.2 18.9 16.5 22.4 20.8 ...
 #$ CellsPerMg                             : num  0 0 0 62341 59481 ...
 #$ CarbsPerMgProt                         : num  0.01063 0.00966 0.0098 0.00815 0.01894 ...
 #$ PerActivity..μmoles.min.mg.protein.    : num  116495 67317 83813 165238 186367 ...
 #$ Phenoloxidase..U.mg.
library(dplyr)
data_baseline_log <- data_baseline %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, log) 

# Convert matrix to data frame
data_baseline_log <- as.data.frame(data_baseline_log)

# Select specific columns by name
data_baseline_log_pca <- data_baseline_log[, c("Strain", "State", "sample_id", "totProt", "CarbsPerMgProt", "PerActivity", "Phenoloxidase", "Treatment")]
# re-name columns for legibility on plots
colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)[colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)=="totProt"] <-"Prot"
colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)[colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)=="CarbsPerMgProt"] <-"Carbs"
colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)[colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)=="PerActivity"] <-"POX"
colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)[colnames(data_baseline_log_pca)=="Phenoloxidase"] <-"PO"
str(data_baseline_log_pca)

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(data_baseline_log_pca[,4:7], scale.unit = TRUE, ncp = 10, graph = TRUE)
# correlations variables - dimensions
# Adding PCA results to the data frame
data_baseline_log_pca$PC1 <- pca_result$x[, 1]
data_baseline_log_pca$PC2 <- pca_result$x[, 2]

# Get the summary of PCA
summary_pca <- summary(pca_result)
# Calculate the percentage of explained variance
percentage_explained_variance <- summary_pca$sdev^2 / sum(summary_pca$sdev^2) * 100
# Print or use the percentage of explained variance for each dimension
print(percentage_explained_variance)
# Create PCA biplot with factorextra

adonis1<-adonis(pca_result$x~State*Strain,data=data_baseline, method = 'eu')
head(adonis1$aov.tab)
pca<-fviz_pca_biplot(pca_result, label = "var", col.var = "black", labelsize = 5, habillage =data_baseline$State, geom.ind = "point", col.ind = data_baseline$State,
                              legend.title = "Strain", repel = FALSE,alpha.ind = 0) + geom_point(aes(shape=data_baseline$Strain,col= data_baseline$State,fill= data_baseline$State), size = 4, stroke = 1)+stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", type = "t", alpha = 0.2, 
              aes(fill= data_baseline$State))+scale_fill_manual(values = col)+scale_color_manual(values = col)+ scale_shape_manual(values = shapes)
pca
pca1<-pca + labs( x = "PC1 (73.16% explained variance)", #get this from output of fviz_eig() above
           y = "PC2 (17.55% explained variance)") + #get this from output of fviz_eig() above
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")) 
pca1
```

```{r Read Fv/Fm plot}

nubs<-read.csv("Final_PAM_Data_Aug2023.csv")
str(nubs)
#Organize matrix, rename columns
nubmeans <- nubs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, Day, sym_state)
data_bub <- nubmeans %>%
  mutate(Symbio_state = ifelse(substr(sym_state, 1, 1) == "A", "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"))
data_bub <- data_bub %>%
  mutate(Strain = case_when(substr(sym_state, 2, 2) == "C" ~ "CC7",
                                substr(sym_state, 2, 2) == "H" ~ "H2",
                                substr(sym_state, 2, 2) == "V" ~ "VWB",
                                TRUE ~ "Unknown"))
#greap all treament codes and make another column named Treat
rename <- function(word) {
  if (grepl("CC$", word)) {
    return("Control")
  } else if (grepl("CH$", word)) {
    return("Heat")
  } else if (grepl("NC$", word)) {
    return("Nitrate")
  } else if (grepl("NH$", word)) {
    return("Heat+Nitrate")
  } else {
    return("gray")  # Default color for other words
  }
}
data_bub$Treatment <- sapply(data_bub$treatment, rename)
```

```{r}
str(data)
###Baseline protein significance###
#test significance for Total protein
# Fit the mixed-effects model
m1 <- aov(totProt ~ State*Strain, data=data_baseline)
summary(m1)
check_normality(m1)
Anova(m1)
#pairwise of treatments within symbiotic state. This stats will be reported in the manuscript.
res_m1<-lsmeans(m1, pairwise~State*State, adjust="tukey")
sum_tot<-cld(res_m1)
sum_tot
#save summary report of stats as csv. the file contains significance comparison where different numbers within column groups mean significant difference.
write.csv(sum_tot, "~/Desktop/totProt_summary_baseline_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Get ALL summary report as data frame
res_m1_df <- summary(res_m1)$contrasts
# Save FULL lsmeans summary as CSV. this results go to the supplemental table.
write.csv(res_m1_df, "~/Desktop/totProt_FULLsummary_baseline_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
str(data_baseline)
###Baseline Peroxidase Activity significance###
# Fit the mixed-effects model

m3 <- aov(PerActivity ~ State*Strain, data=data_baseline)
summary(m3)
check_normality(m3)
#Warning: Non-normality of residuals detected (p = 0.046). Data were non normal. normalized data using log (data + 1)
data_baseline$PerActivity_log<-log(data_baseline$PerActivity + 2)
m3 <- aov(PerActivity_log ~ State*Strain, data=data_baseline)
summary(m3)
check_normality(m3)
#OK: residuals appear as normally distributed (p = 0.073).
Anova(m3)
#pairwise of treatments within symbiotic state. This stats will be reported in the manuscript.
res_m3<-lsmeans(m3, pairwise~State*State, adjust="tukey")
sum_per<-cld(res_m3)
sum_per
#save summary report of stats as csv. the file contains significance comparison where different numbers within column groups mean significant difference.
write.csv(sum_per, "~/Desktop/per_summary_baseline_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Get ALL summary report as data frame
res_m3_df <- summary(res_m3)$contrasts
res_m3_df
# Save FULL lsmeans summary as CSV. this results go to the supplemental table.
write.csv(res_m3_df, "~/Desktop/per_FULLsummary_baseline_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Convert matrix to data frame
data_baseline <- as.data.frame(data_baseline)

# Select specific columns by name
data_baseline<- data_baseline[, c("Strain", "State", "sample_id", "totProt", "CarbsPerMgProt", "PerActivity", "Phenoloxidase", "Treatment")]
# re-name columns for legibility on plots
str(data_baseline)
colnames(data_baseline)[colnames(data_baseline)=="totProt"] <-"Prot"
colnames(data_baseline)[colnames(data_baseline)=="CarbsPerMgProt"] <-"Carbs"
colnames(data_baseline)[colnames(data_baseline)=="PerActivity"] <-"POX"
colnames(data_baseline)[colnames(data_baseline)=="Phenoloxidase"] <-"PO"

str(data_baseline)

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(data_baseline[,4:7], scale.unit = TRUE, ncp = 10, graph = TRUE)
# correlations variables - dimensions
# Adding PCA results to the data frame
data_baseline$PC1 <- pca_result$x[, 1]
data_baseline$PC2 <- pca_result$x[, 2]

# Get the summary of PCA
summary_pca <- summary(pca_result)
# Calculate the percentage of explained variance
percentage_explained_variance <- summary_pca$sdev^2 / sum(summary_pca$sdev^2) * 100
# Print or use the percentage of explained variance for each dimension
print(percentage_explained_variance)
# Create PCA biplot with factorextra
adonis1<-adonis(pca_result$x~State*Strain,data=data_baseline, method = 'eu')
head(adonis1$aov.tab)
```

```{r}
Anova(m1)
#pairwise of treatments within symbiotic state. This stats will be reported in the manuscript.
res_m1<-lsmeans(m1, pairwise~Treatment|State, adjust="tukey")
sum_tot<-cld(res_m1)
write.csv(sum_tot, "~/Desktop/totProt_summary_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Get summary as data frame
res_m1_df <- summary(res_m1)$contrasts
# Save lsmeans summary as CSV
write.csv(res_m1_df, "~/Desktop/totProt_FULLsummary_MS.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#pairwise of all treatments of strains and symbiotic state
res_m1.5<-lsmeans(m1, pairwise~Treatment*State, adjust="tukey")
sum_tot_all<-cld(res_m1.5)
write.csv(sum_tot_all, "~/Desktop/sum_tot_all_comparisomn_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Get summary as data frame
res_m1.5_df <- summary(res_m1.5)$contrasts
# Save lsmeans summary as CSV
write.csv(res_m1.5_df, "~/Desktop/res_m1_df_totProt_ALLsummary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
data_sym$PC2 <- pca_result$x[, 2]

pca_result
```
